concept.zh: 嵌套重复片段的长度与随机读取
concept.en: Length and indexed reads from nested repeats

brief.zh: tokens 是压缩电报。["emit",字符] 放入一个字符，["open",次数] 开启重复段，["close"] 把整段按次数重复。段可嵌套或留空，括号已配对，次数为正整数。返回 [展开后的长度, 各次读到的字符列表]。positions 从 0 编号，负数或越界填空字符串。展开长度最高可达一百万。
brief.en: tokens describes a compressed message. ["emit",character] emits one character. ["open",count] starts a repeat and ["close"] repeats that entire group count times. Groups may nest or be empty, pairs are balanced, and counts are positive integers. Return [expanded length, list of characters at positions]. Positions are zero-based. Use an empty string for a negative or out-of-range index. The expanded length may reach one million.

solutionCode:
def tape_probe(tokens, positions):
    children = [[]]
    sizes = [0]
    repeats = [1]
    chars = [""]
    stack = [0]
    for token in tokens:
        parent = stack[-1]
        if token[0] == "close":
            stack.pop()
            sizes[stack[-1]] += sizes[parent] * repeats[parent]
        else:
            node = len(sizes)
            children[parent].append(node)
            children.append([])
            if token[0] == "open":
                sizes.append(0)
                repeats.append(token[1])
                chars.append("")
                stack.append(node)
            else:
                sizes.append(1)
                repeats.append(1)
                chars.append(token[1])
                sizes[parent] += 1
    found = []
    for position in positions:
        letter = ""
        node = 0
        if position >= 0 and position < sizes[0]:
            while chars[node] == "":
                for child in children[node]:
                    span = sizes[child] * repeats[child]
                    if position < span:
                        position = position % sizes[child]
                        node = child
                        break
                    position -= span
            letter = chars[node]
        found.append(letter)
    return [sizes[0], found]
